body:
Our refund and return policy is on its own page, and it is short and specific. This article explains it in plain English, with examples, so you know what to expect before you buy and what to do if you need to return something. If anything here differs from the [refund policy](/refunds/) page, the policy page applies. It is written for adults aged 21 and over, and it is general information about our own policy, not legal advice.

## The 30-day window
Returns and exchanges must be requested within 30 days of the purchase date. The clock starts on the day you purchased, not the day the parcel arrives, so with the longer carrier times in the east, do not wait. If you think you may want to return something, check it as soon as it arrives and contact us early. Requests made after 30 days cannot be accepted.

## How to start a return
Contact us before sending anything back so that we can issue an RMA form. RMA stands for return merchandise authorization, and it is the paper that ties your return to your order. Returns without an RMA cannot be guaranteed a refund or exchange. Use the [contact page](/contact/), email, WhatsApp or phone to begin. Tell us your order ID, which item you want to return and why. We will reply with instructions and the RMA form, and the mailing address for returns:

Attention: Returns, 4908 E McDowell Road STE 103, Phoenix, Arizona 85008.

## What a refund includes
After we receive the product, we issue your refund back through the same payment method the payment was received through, whether that is Cash App, Apple Pay, Chime, cryptocurrency or a gift card, minus a 15% restocking fee. Shipping fees are not refunded, and you are responsible for the cost of shipping the product back to us. We do not provide prepaid return labels, and we recommend adding insurance and tracking when you send it, because you are responsible until we receive it.

### A worked example
You buy two bottles at $12.00 each and a device at $40.00, a $64.00 product total, and pay by Chime with $15.00 shipping, $79.00 in all. You return the unopened device within 30 days. We issue a refund of the device price less 15%: $40.00 minus $6.00 is $34.00, returned through Chime. The $15.00 shipping is not refunded, and you paid to ship the device back. The bottles stay with you.

### How the discount affects a refund
If you paid by crypto or gift card, the 10% discount was applied to your product subtotal. A refund is calculated from what you actually paid for the returned item, so it already reflects the discount, less the 15% restocking fee.

## Exchanges
We are happy to exchange within 30 days of purchase. When the returned items are received, a customer service representative will call to clarify what you would like in exchange and place your order with you over the phone. You are only responsible for the remaining amount if the new item is worth more. A standard shipping fee applies to exchange orders where the order does not qualify for free shipping. Contact us first so we can send the RMA form.

## What we cannot accept
Because of FDA regulation and hygiene, some items cannot be returned:

- **Opened and used e-liquid.**
- **Opened and used devices and accessories.**
- **Products not purchased on onestopvapestore.com.**
- **Shipping fees,** which are not refundable.
- **Partially returned or opened sample packs and bundle deals.**
- **Puffco products,** which do not qualify for refunds or exchanges even if unopened.

If you are not sure whether an item qualifies, ask before you open it. Once opened, a product cannot be returned, and that includes testing a flavor, so decide carefully, especially on a larger bottle or a bundle.

## Returned by the carrier
If a carrier returns an undelivered package, for example because no one was available to sign, we process a refund minus the 15% restocking fee and the shipping cost, as described in the [shipping policy](/shipping/). That is a different situation from a customer return, and it does not need an RMA. To avoid it, plan for the signature. See [adult signature on delivery](/blog/adult-signature-on-delivery-what-to-expect/).

## Damaged, defective or wrong items
If your parcel arrives damaged or you receive the wrong item, do not follow the standard return route. Photograph the items and the invoice immediately and email us, and we will help you reorder damaged items, as described in the shipping policy. See [damaged or missing items](/blog/damaged-or-missing-items-what-to-do/). A product that arrives damaged is handled differently from one you simply decide you do not want.

## How long does a refund take?
After we receive your return, we check it, issue the refund and tell you. How long it takes to appear depends on the payment method: app payments are usually quick, crypto depends on the network and gift card refunds are handled as we explain at the time. Because crypto transfers are final, refunds are returned in the coin used, and we explain the details when we arrange it.

## Tips for a smooth return
- **Contact us early,** within the 30-day window, and wait for the RMA form.
- **Keep the original packaging** and the invoice.
- **Photograph the items** before you send them.
- **Add tracking and insurance** to your return parcel.
- **Put the RMA in the box.**
- **Keep the tracking number** until we confirm receipt.

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### Can I return something I opened by mistake?
Opened items cannot be returned. If you have a concern about a product, contact us before you open it, or tell us if it arrived damaged.

### Can I return part of an order?
Yes, eligible items can be returned individually within 30 days. Bundles and sample packs cannot be partially returned.

### Who pays for return shipping?
You do. We do not provide prepaid return labels.

### Will you refund the shipping I paid?
No. Shipping fees are not refunded, except in the carrier-returned case described above, where the shipping cost is deducted from the refund.

### Can I exchange instead of refunding?
Yes, within 30 days. A team member will call to arrange it.

### Why is there a restocking fee?
The fee covers the cost of handling, inspecting and restocking returned items. It is 15% of the refunded amount.

## Related
Read [how ordering works](/blog/how-ordering-works/), [how to change or cancel an order](/blog/how-to-change-or-cancel-an-order/) and [how to contact support](/blog/how-to-contact-support/). Browse [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/) and [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/). All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## A step-by-step return from start to finish
1. **Check the window.** You are within 30 days of purchase.
2. **Check eligibility.** The item is unopened, in original packaging, bought from us and not a Puffco product or a partly returned bundle.
3. **Contact us.** Email or call with your order ID and the item you want to return, and say whether you want a refund or an exchange.
4. **Receive the RMA form.** We send it with the return address.
5. **Pack the item.** Use the original packaging, include the RMA form and the invoice, and add tracking and insurance.
6. **Ship it.** You pay the postage, and you keep the tracking number.
7. **We receive and check it.** We confirm that it is unopened and in good condition.
8. **We issue the refund or arrange the exchange.** A refund goes back through the original payment method, less the 15% restocking fee. An exchange is arranged by phone.

## Planning purchases with the policy in mind
If you are trying a new flavor or product, buy a size you are happy to keep, because opened items cannot be returned. If you are buying a device for the first time, read the product page carefully, check the strength and compatibility and ask us if you are unsure, because a question before you buy is much easier than a return afterward. And if you are buying Puffco products, remember that they do not qualify for refunds or exchanges.

## Frequently asked questions about specific situations
### I bought the wrong strength. Can I return it?
If it is unopened and in original packaging, within 30 days and not a Puffco product, yes, with an RMA and the 15% restocking fee, or exchange it for the strength you wanted. If it is opened, it cannot be returned.

### A device arrived and does not turn on. What now?
Contact us with a description and, if you can, a short video. Try the steps in our guides on [charging](/blog/vape-wont-charge-fixes/) and [troubleshooting](/blog/why-is-my-vape-not-hitting/). If it is defective on arrival, we will tell you what to do. Do not try to open the device.

### Can I return an item I bought for someone else?
Returns are handled with the original purchaser, because the refund goes back through the payment method used. If the recipient wants to return it, the purchaser should contact us.

### What if I paid with crypto and the price has changed?
Refunds are based on the dollar amount you paid for the returned item, less the restocking fee, and are returned in the coin used. The coin amount depends on the rate when the refund is made, and we explain how it is calculated when we arrange it.

### How do I know my return arrived?
Use tracking on your return parcel, and contact us if it shows delivered but we have not confirmed receipt. We will check our incoming returns.
